svg.title: How spotexec works
svg.desc: Left: your machine, with three git worktrees (agent-1, agent-2, agent-3) running sx pnpm test, sx pnpm tsc --noEmit and sx pnpm prettier --write .; a fair local queue, nothing hosted and no control plane. Middle, over SSH with your own keys: 1 sync, only the files the slot is missing; 2 run, output and exit code stream back; 3 write back, 3-way checked. Right: your runners. homelab-01 over SSH has both slots busy, Spot VM aws#1 has one of two busy, and aws#2 is idle and powering off. Spot VMs launch for queued work and power themselves off when idle.
